items.title: Josiah 'Cie' Frazier Interview, 1972-01-19
items.q: Sometimes I'd play in there with a fellow by the name of Bud Russel on bass violin, he played the bass violin. A fellow by the name of Arthur William Clarinet. And a man by the name of Leo Sanjay playing banjo.

ctx.x: Two yards, you see, facing, as we come in on that street, hominist street, facing the club. Well, to your right of the building, I see the other day when we was up there, they had some houses given to them. Well, they had a yard on that side. And then, you know, to the left of the building, like this would be the front of the building, like this, this would be the right, like I'm facing you, and this would be the left.
